---
title: "My Publications"
---

Over the past decade, I have been involved in a diverse array of projects with one [unifying theme]{.underline}: to better understand and improve population health for all.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(httr2)
library(readr)

# --- Zotero credentials ---
# ZOTERO_API_KEY is read from the environment (set in a local, gitignored
# .Renviron file for development, and in Netlify's Environment Variables
# for the live site) — never hardcode it here since this repo is public.
zotero_user_id        <- "2067478"
zotero_api_key        <- Sys.getenv("ZOTERO_API_KEY")
zotero_collection_key <- "U8TJFSUK"

# --- Theme order (must match your Zotero tags exactly) ---
theme_order <- c(
  "Recent Work",
  "Nurses Health Studies",
  "Harm Reduction & Substance Use Behaviors",
  "Malaria Drug Development"
)

# --- Optional: blurbs shown under each theme heading ---
theme_desc_url <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vTQwbP30e1rj9eR6NlSgrRrSbZybMghHNGoXHa2GylcFEaJjL3SP5j4-EdyG3Qj4MizkSyLRW9QH0dT/pub?gid=2132852220&single=true&output=csv"
theme_descriptions <- read_csv(theme_desc_url, show_col_types = FALSE)

# --- Fetch all items in the specified collection (paginated), filtered to relevant item types ---
fetch_all_zotero_items <- function(user_id, api_key, collection_key) {
  items <- list()
  start <- 0
  repeat {
    resp <- request("https://api.zotero.org") |>
      req_url_path_append("users", user_id, "collections", collection_key, "items") |>
      req_url_query(
        itemType = "journalArticle || preprint || thesis",
        sort = "date",
        direction = "desc",
        limit = 100,
        start = start
      ) |>
      req_headers(`Zotero-API-Key` = api_key) |>
      req_perform()

    batch <- resp_body_json(resp, simplifyVector = FALSE)
    items <- c(items, batch)
    if (length(batch) < 100) break
    start <- start + 100
  }
  items
}

all_items <- fetch_all_zotero_items(zotero_user_id, zotero_api_key, zotero_collection_key)

# --- Helpers ---

or_blank <- function(x) if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0 || is.na(x)) "" else x

format_authors <- function(creators) {
  parts <- vapply(creators, function(c) {
    if (!is.null(c$lastName)) {
      first <- or_blank(c$firstName)
      initials <- if (nzchar(first)) {
        paste0(vapply(strsplit(first, " ")[[1]], function(x) substr(x, 1, 1), character(1)), collapse = "")
      } else ""
      name <- trimws(paste(c$lastName, initials))
      if (identical(c$lastName, "Frueh")) name <- paste0("**", name, "**")
      name
    } else if (!is.null(c$name)) {
      c$name
    } else ""
  }, character(1))
  paste(parts, collapse = ", ")
}

extract_year <- function(date) {
  m <- regmatches(date, regexpr("\\d{4}", date))
  if (length(m) == 0) "" else m
}

extract_pdf <- function(item_key, user_id, api_key, dest_dir = "docs/zotero") {
  children_resp <- tryCatch({
    request("https://api.zotero.org") |>
      req_url_path_append("users", user_id, "items", item_key, "children") |>
      req_headers(`Zotero-API-Key` = api_key) |>
      req_perform()
  }, error = function(e) NULL)

  if (is.null(children_resp)) return(NA_character_)

  children <- resp_body_json(children_resp, simplifyVector = FALSE)
  pdf_children <- Filter(function(c) {
    identical(c$data$itemType, "attachment") &&
      identical(c$data$contentType, "application/pdf")
  }, children)

  if (length(pdf_children) == 0) return(NA_character_)

  attachment_key <- pdf_children[[1]]$data$key
  dir.create(dest_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  local_path <- file.path(dest_dir, paste0(item_key, ".pdf"))

  if (!file.exists(local_path)) {
    result <- tryCatch({
      request("https://api.zotero.org") |>
        req_url_path_append("users", user_id, "items", attachment_key, "file") |>
        req_headers(`Zotero-API-Key` = api_key) |>
        req_perform(path = local_path)
      TRUE
    }, error = function(e) FALSE)
    if (!result) return(NA_character_)
  }

  paste0("/", local_path)
}

item_tags <- function(d) vapply(d$tags, function(t) t$tag, character(1))

render_pub <- function(item) {
  d <- item$data
  authors <- format_authors(d$creators)
  title <- d$title
  year <- extract_year(or_blank(d$date))
  pdf <- extract_pdf(d$key, zotero_user_id, zotero_api_key)
  doi <- or_blank(d$DOI)
  url <- or_blank(d$url)
  link <- if (nzchar(doi)) paste0("https://doi.org/", doi) else if (nzchar(url)) url else NA_character_

  citation <- switch(d$itemType,
    journalArticle = sprintf(
      "%s. %s. *%s*. %s;%s%s%s.",
      authors, title, or_blank(d$publicationTitle), year,
      if (nzchar(or_blank(d$volume))) d$volume else "",
      if (nzchar(or_blank(d$issue))) sprintf("(%s)", d$issue) else "",
      if (nzchar(or_blank(d$pages))) sprintf(":%s", d$pages) else ""
    ),
    preprint = sprintf(
      "%s. %s. *%s*. %s.",
      authors, title, if (nzchar(or_blank(d$repository))) d$repository else "Preprint", year
    ),
    thesis = sprintf(
      "%s. %s \\[Internet\\] \\[%s\\]. %s; %s.",
      authors, title, if (nzchar(or_blank(d$thesisType))) d$thesisType else "Thesis",
      or_blank(d$university), year
    ),
    sprintf("%s. %s. %s.", authors, title, year)
  )

  links <- c()
  if (!is.na(link)) links <- c(links, sprintf("[Link](%s)", link))
  if (!is.na(pdf)) links <- c(links, sprintf("[PDF](%s)", pdf))
  link_str <- if (length(links) > 0) paste0(" ", paste(links, collapse = " \\| ")) else ""

  cat(sprintf("1.  %s%s\n\n", citation, link_str))
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

cat("## Peer Reviewed Publications\n\n")

journal_items <- Filter(function(item) identical(item$data$itemType, "journalArticle"), all_items)

for (theme in theme_order) {
  theme_items <- Filter(function(item) theme %in% item_tags(item$data), journal_items)
  if (length(theme_items) == 0) next

  cat(sprintf("### %s\n\n", theme))

  blurb_row <- theme_descriptions[theme_descriptions$Theme == theme, ]
  if (nrow(blurb_row) > 0 && !is.na(blurb_row$Description[1]) && nzchar(trimws(blurb_row$Description[1]))) {
    cat(sprintf("<details>%s</details>\n\n", blurb_row$Description[1]))
  }

  for (item in theme_items) render_pub(item)
}

cat("## Under Review / Preprint\n\n")

preprint_items <- Filter(function(item) identical(item$data$itemType, "preprint"), all_items)
for (item in preprint_items) render_pub(item)

cat("## Theses\n\n")

thesis_items <- Filter(function(item) identical(item$data$itemType, "thesis"), all_items)
for (item in thesis_items) render_pub(item)
```
